title: Flank Steak and Chimichurri Night
notes: About 75 minutes start to table. Oven to 450°F and steak out first, wedges in by 15 minutes, chimichurri while they roast, grill the steak in the last 15 minutes, glaze the wedges and dress the salad while the steak rests. Optional: swap the chimichurri for Chipotle Compound Butter (make it first so it can chill).
